phrase.zh: 把难以看见的事物，带到眼前。

visual.zh: 带有深浅斑块的宽叶从底部伸入画面，分叉叶脉清楚可见，右上方一束细杆相互交叠，周围留出空白。
visual.en: A broad mottled leaf rises from the bottom, its branching veins clearly drawn; slender rods overlap above right within open space.

background.zh:
斯坦利分离了烟草花叶病毒的结晶材料。他与诺思罗普因制备纯净形式的酶和病毒蛋白，各获得1946年诺贝尔化学奖的四分之一奖项。画面用带斑块的烟草叶与分离的细杆形体联系植物和病毒材料，是原创寓意；不是显微照片，细杆的大小和排列也不表示实验结果。短句为原创。
1946年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的四分之一。获奖理由（中文译述）：制备纯净形式的酶和病毒蛋白。
background.en:
Stanley isolated crystalline tobacco mosaic virus material. He and Northrop each received a quarter of the 1946 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for preparing enzymes and virus proteins in pure form. A mottled tobacco leaf and separated rod forms associate plant and virus material in an original metaphor. This is not microscopy; rod size and arrangement do not represent experimental results. The phrase is original.
1946 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received one-quarter of the prize. Official motivation: for their preparation of enzymes and virus proteins in a pure form
